rounds.text: Kalyani Forge demonstrates exceptional operational momentum driven by structural margin expansion, as evidenced by its TTM operating margin widening by 8 percentage points to 14% [E30] and June 2026 quarterly operating margin reaching 16% [E31], which propelled a 245% 3-year compound profit growth [E20] and 55% 5-year compound profit growth [E19, E57]. This operational acceleration is backed by completed capex, with capital work-in-progress down 33.3% as new capacity comes online [E40], alongside strong macro support from a sector tailwind in Capital Goods [E68, E70]. From a valuation stance, historical underlying performance has outpaced the stock price with 5-year profit growth of 55% exceeding share price growth of 38% [E54], while a discounted cash flow analysis estimates intrinsic value at Rs 1330 per share versus a market price of Rs 990, yielding a 25.6% margin of safety [E43, E44] where current prices reflect implied earnings growth of just 13.9% against an 18.0% base case [E45]. Technical price action confirms this underlying momentum, highlighted by a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E49], price trading cleanly above its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E48], and an overall screen score of 88 out of 100 [E63]. Conceded: the business carries notable financial balance sheet risks, including flat 10-year compounded sales growth of 0% [E14], high leverage with debt to equity at 1.10x [E38], high debtor days of 160 days [E62], and a negative free cash flow of Rs -26 Cr in March 2026 [E36].
